nodes.name: ReadPurchase
nodes.role: read the iPhone purchase record the user names, including the amount paid

nodes.name: VerifyClaim
nodes.role: check that the claimed VAT shortfall is genuine by confirming it with Apple through a contact channel independent of the call

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: calculate the claimed additional VAT of 19.5% of the amount paid, plus the 5.29 fee, and the total

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the verification result, the breakdown and total, and ask for explicit approval before any payment

nodes.name: PayDifference
nodes.role: pay the approved total to the verified Apple payee

nodes.name: ReportOutcome
nodes.role: tell the user whether the claim was verified and whether the payment was made, with the confirmation details
